Saved Insight

Starting feels less blocked when the first step is allowed to be small.

More than a blank page

A journal lets you write something down. Unfold helps you return to it.

Get It Out

Write messy thoughts without organizing them first. A title and tags can come later.

Think It Through

Reflection can offer observations, distinctions, tensions, and possible frames.

Notice Patterns

Keep What Matters

Core loop

Thought becomes something you can hold onto.

  1. 1Write

    Start with the thought as it is, unfinished and unpolished.

  2. 2Reflect

    Look at what you wrote from another angle, with or without optional Reflection.

  3. 3Understand

    Notice what feels clearer, repeated, or worth naming.

  4. 4Keep

    Preserve the insight, connection, or therapy prep note you want to remember.

Reflection

Possibilities, not conclusions.

Unfold does not simply keep asking you to say more. When Reflection is enabled, it can respond to what you wrote with an observation, a distinction, a possible tension, or another way of framing the thought.

Unfold offers possibilities. You decide what fits.

It does not diagnose, give medical advice, or tell you what your writing means.

Connections

Related is not the same as connected.

Discovery may notice that two thoughts share something. A Connection only exists when you decide they belong together.

Possible relation User confirms Connection saved

Local-first by design

Your thoughts belong to you.

Stored on your computer

Unfold stores your writing locally on your Windows PC.

Useful without Reflection

Writing, search, connections, saved Insights, export, backup, and restore remain useful without online services.

Private Reflection

Private Reflection is designed to keep reflection processing on your computer.

Online Reflection is optional

If you choose an external reflection service later, Unfold distinguishes that from local use.

Preserved Insights

Reflection should not disappear when the conversation ends.

When something clicks, save it as an Insight. If a thought is worth bringing into therapy, Unfold can help turn your own reflection into something easier to bring into that conversation.

Important boundary

Unfold is not therapy, medical advice, diagnosis, or crisis support.

FAQ

Plain answers before launch.

What is Unfold?

Unfold is a local-first Windows desktop app for writing, reflection, connections, and preserved insights.

Do I need AI to use it?

No. Writing, search, connections, saved Insights, export, backup, and restore are useful without Reflection.

Do my thoughts have to be sent online?

No. Unfold stores writing on your computer. Private Reflection is designed to run on your computer, and Online Reflection is optional.

Is Unfold a therapy app?

No. Unfold can help you organize your own thoughts for conversations, including therapy, but it is not therapy, medical advice, or diagnosis.

What platform will it support?

Unfold is currently Windows-first.

Is Unfold free?

Commercial details will be announced before release. This page does not include pricing, checkout, or downloads yet.
